newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Jan-Feb net wages up 25.9pct y/y - Stat off.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Jan-Feb net wages up 25.9pct y/y - Stat off.

text.p: Average net monthly wage in the January-February period in Hungary's business sphere rose to 35,300 forints, up 25.9 percent on the similar period of 1996, the Central Statistical Office (KSH) said on Tuesday.
This compares to a CPI increase of 18.9 percent over the same period, resulting in a 5.9 percent increase in real wages, the KSH said.
It added that white-collar workers' wages rose 12.2 percent while blue collar workers' wages rose 1.3 percent in real terms.
The KSH said earlier today that Hungary's monthly average real wages, including the business sphere, the agricultural sector and public institutions fell five percent in 1996.
